name: sabai
description: Pixel-art band above the prompt: folder, git and node; task progress with Clawd and his moods; a row of subagents; context, session and weekly limits; a toolbar. A Subagents pane with reports, and a Settings pane with raised or flat cards (light and dark), bar styles, alerts and an optional guard with per-rule Block / Ask. In the conversation: tool calls as one-line rows, test results, callout boxes and a receipt at the end of each working turn.
